collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IX (161-180, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: One child hates sweeping and another hates fetching water, and a very serious negotiation begins.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) hates sweeping. (friend) hates fetching water. They have just realized this about each other, and a negotiation has begun. It is very serious. It involves a great deal of pointing.

choices.label: Try to Get a Better Deal

a.name: Answer A
a.text: After much discussion, they agree: (subject) will fetch water for a week, and (friend) will sweep for a week. They shake hands. It works perfectly for two days. On the third day they discover that they both secretly miss their old chores a tiny bit, and neither of them will admit it.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "I'll fetch water," says (subject), "if you sweep AND give me your fruit at lunch." (friend) narrows (friend.his/her) eyes. The negotiations go on so long that both of them are late with their chores, and the grown-ups have to do them. The two children spend the rest of the afternoon blaming each other cheerfully.
